reasoning: On the season so far the Warriors are the stronger team; with home court the Warriors start about 7 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Warriors win 68 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 200 and 249 total points.
